subject: health
concept: Practicing simple, confident refusal skills for when someone offers something that doesn't feel right or safe
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the Boundaries Pillar and bully-response training — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student practices saying a simple, confident refusal phrase in a role-play scenario
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an uncomfortable offer scenario to a confident refusal response
exercise.abstract: Student explains why it's okay to say no clearly, even to a friend or older peer

misconception_flags: believes saying no to a peer offering something unsafe would be rude rather than appropriate

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
